messages:
eva: Quick sync 1: Zeno agreed to an instrumentation-first benchmark for perf/W and stability. Goal: reproducible artifacts we can cite in a partner brief. Runs next Tue

liam: Nice. Zeno will supply per-board ADC power traces at 500Hz and a CSV dump. Asking they also export SoC DVFS states via sysfs.

sofia: Can we scope the models? Proposing `redwood/sm-7b` and `redwood/sm-1.3b` for scale points. Use fp16 baseline + int8 dynamic quant on 7b.

liam: Agree. Also test two thermal profiles: "ambient" (22C) and "elevated" (30C) to show perf/W delta.

ops: Infrastructure note: lab will have 3x ZS-32-L boards in rack B6, PDUs instrumented with Yocto meters. S3: s3://redwood-partners/zeno-ci-19766.

zeno_ci_bot: Zeno CI: exporter endpoint added -> https://metrics.zeno/teams/ci/zeno-19766; prometheus labels include `zone=b6` and `board_id`. Default scrape=1000ms.

eva: Run matrix (draft): models=[sm-1.3b,sm-7b]; batch=[1,2,8]; seq=[128,1024]; quant=[fp16,int8]; thermal=[ambient,elevated]; kernel=[stock,tuned-dvfs]. Each combination: warmup 5k tokens, steady 20min.

sofia: For kernel knobs let's focus on DVFS and scheduler. Proposed tuned set: echo performance > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor; set `cpu_dma_latency=0`; disable `sched_autogroup`. We'll capture `/proc/cmdline` and `/sys/devices/system/cpu/*/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq` sampling during run.

liam: Add firmware flash id & microcode versions to metadata. If we see >7% perf variance across repeated runs, flag as flaky and retryx2.

ops: I'll provision a lightweight runner that writes `run_manifest.json` with fields: run_id, model, batch, seq, quant, thermal, kernel, git_sha, firmware, start_ts, end_ts. All runs pushed to s3 after finish.

sofia: For power correlation: we'll align ADC timestamps with `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw --format=csv,noheader,nounits -l 0.5` and the board ADC at 500Hz; include cross-correlation script in repo.

eva: Communication: if numbers are public, we need a joint PR draft and 48h embargo. @liam will coordinate comms preview with Zeno.

liam: I'll draft PR and share for review. Also request a short quote from Zeno Eng for the partner blog.

sofia: Quick snippet to run a standardized trial (put in repo `ci/run_standard.sh`):

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
MODEL=$1
BATCH=$2
SEQ=$3
LABEL=$4
./inference_runner --model $MODEL --batch $BATCH --seq $SEQ --profile prometheus --duration 1200 --label "${LABEL}"
# upload run_manifest.json and metrics to s3
```

eva: Nice. Ops, can you also add a grafana dashboard template with panels: tokens/s, p95 latency, gpu_power (ADC), board_power (ADC), perf_per_w, dvfs_state?

ops: On it. Will add annotations for `run_id` and `git_sha`. Alert: if perf_per_w drops >10% from baseline, create an incident ticket for triage.

zeno_ci_bot: Zeno infra note: We have a rolling kernel patch that touches NVLink stack; will test both with/without patch. Storage note: current bucket retention is 60d; approving push to 90d for this project.

liam: Excellent. Action list: 1) ops: dashboard + runner + s3 retention, 2) sofia: kernel/DVFS doc + correlation scripts, 3) eva: PR/comm draft + embargo plan, 4) zeno: confirm ADC CSV schema and DVFS export path.

sofia: Will also add `journalctl -o short-precise` capture and `perf stat -e cpu-clock,context-switches -I 1000` for first 2 minutes to give system-level correlations.

eva: Dry run Friday 10:00 PT with Zeno engs. If green, full run Tue 09:00 PT. I'll send calendar invites. :email: 

liam: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until dry run passes.
